hook.text: Two people want to split $100. If they agree on a split, they keep it. If not, both get nothing.

buildup.text: This is the bargaining problem: how do rational agents divide a surplus when both must consent?

discovery.text: Any split from 1/99 to 99/1 is better than nothing—yet people consistently reject unfair offers.

twist.text: Fairness matters. Experiments show people sacrifice money to punish offers they consider insulting.

climax.text: Bargaining theory explains salary talks, trade deals, divorces—anywhere two sides must agree to benefit.

punchline.text: Splitting the pie is harder than making it.

quiz.question: What happens if bargainers can't agree?
